title: Automated excellence in salmon slicing just got faster
summary: The new Multi Angle Slicer MSC 255 from JBT Marel is here, bringing high-throughput, precision slicing to the salmon industry.
body_markdown:
Having the inbuilt flexibility and ease of control in a slicer is needed to explore new product ranges and keep up with the changing demands of a high-growth ready-to-eat market. The MSC 255 cutting knife adjusts between 8 to 80 degrees, so a single machine can slice thin, angled portions and broader, straighter cuts to meet given customer order requests. And slice angles can be easily changed via an intuitive user interface, with minimal training required for safe and efficient operation.


##### Precision that protects yield


Every cut of salmon risks yield loss. Uneven or oversized slices downgrade product quality and reduce profits. The[MSC 255](https://jbtmarel.com/en/products/multi-angle-slicer-msc-255/) uses a unique rotating cutting-block to hold the angle and knife steady increasing precision that keeps slices consistent and reduces giveaway. This level of reliable accuracy in every cut results in better yields, over every production run.


##### Stable production with higher uptime


Software is a critical tool in today’s salmon industry. It connects processors to their operational data in real-time. This insight over production enables decision making that is based on data, rather than on gut feel. The MSC 255 is ready to connect to JBT Marel Software, and ensure your data is working for you. Machine health monitoring through AXIN Machine Solutions helps prevent unexpected downtimes, and makes sure your investment runs at its optimum.


##### Hygiene built into the design


Sanitation and high-hygiene standards are ingrained into salmon processing facilities. Having equipment that is hard to clean creates a contamination risk and slows down changeovers or end of shift handovers. The MSC 255 was designed with hygiene as a starting point:


- Open, accessible surfaces
- Full cleaning of turn plate possible
- Roller designed with fewer parts
- Hygienic belt design


Providing processors with a slicing machine that reduces cleaning time while supporting the highest standards of hygiene.
